summary: Join our interactive dashboards training course to learn Dash and Streamlit. Transform your data into engaging visuals and enhance your analytical skills!
lede: Interactive Dashboards with Dash and Streamlit shows you how to transform raw data into clear, clickable views that help stakeholders explore answers without relying on static reports or constant support. You’ll learn to define dashboard objectives and create user-friendly layouts for KPIs, budgets, operations, and outcome reporting. Using practical Python tools, you’ll connect dashboards to real-world data sources and add filters, drilldowns, and selections that make analysis more useful. The course also covers basic access-control patterns, responsible deployment, and hands-on templates that can be adapted across different types of organizations.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who need to effectively communicate insights, enhance performance visibility, and deliver interactive reporting tools across various sectors.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic Python knowledge and familiarity with data analysis concepts. No prior experience with Dash or Streamlit is required.
